📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This change enhances accessibility in the product grid component by adding ARIA attributes and a live region. Specifically, it introduces a polite live region for status announcements, aria-labels for interactive controls, and aria-pressed states for filter selections to improve screen reader support. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Accessibility Enhancements**
